All 13 Indian Nationals Rescued After Vessel Sinks Off Yemen

The Ministry of External Affairs (MEA) has confirmed that all 13 Indian nationals aboard the Indian-flagged commercial vessel MSV Faize Noore Oliya have been safely rescued after it sank in the Red Sea off the coast of Yemen following an attack.

In a statement, the MEA strongly condemned the attack and said the Indian Embassy in Riyadh is coordinating with Yemeni authorities to ensure the safety and well-being of the crew. The ministry also thanked the Yemeni authorities for their assistance.

All crew members are reported safe, and further details about the attack are awaited.
